name: OpeningHoursEditor
tagline: The Opening Hours Editor replaces a plain text box with a simple weekly timetable.
description: The Opening Hours Editor replaces a plain text box with a simple weekly timetable. For each day you choose Open, Closed or 24 hours, and pick the opening and closing times. A day can have more than one time slot, for example a lunch break or a split shift.
features: Closed or 24 hours per day, split shifts
Live 'open now' status and a readable summary such as 'Mon-Fri 09:00-18:00, Sat 09:00-13:00
